verses.1: For all times and moments, for every desire, under the heavens.
verses.2: Time to give birth, and time to die; time to make mistakes, and time to stay silent.
verses.3: There is time to destroy, and there is also time to heal. There is time to destroy, and there is also time to grow.
verses.4: Time for crying, and time for laughing. Time for sadness, and time for joy.
verses.5: There is a time to lay stones, and there is also a time to remove them. There is a time to be close together, and there is also a time to be far apart from each other.
verses.6: There are times to seek, and there are times to lose. There are times to preserve, and there are times to abandon.
verses.7: Time to act, and time to rest. Time to think, and time to speak.
verses.8: There is time for love, and there is also time for war. There is time for peace.
verses.9: What will be the outcome of what he is doing?
verses.10: I saw the problem that God gave to human beings, so that they could suffer because of it.
verses.11: He did all this beautifully in his time. He also gave them the world, so that they would not have to wonder about what God had done from beginning to end.
verses.12: I knew that there was no good in them, except for their own pleasure and doing good in their lives.
verses.13: And also, every person who eats and drinks, and sees good in all their efforts, is blessed by God.
verses.14: I knew that everything that God does will last forever. There’s nothing that can be added to it, and nothing that can be taken away from it. God has created things so that they may be seen before Him.
verses.15: What he was long ago, and what he always has been, God will surely demand his punishment.
verses.16: And I also saw under the sun the place where injustice was established, and the place where justice was established.
verses.17: I say that in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked. For it is time for every person to be judged according to their actions.
verses.18: I say that in my heart, I agree with what the children of men say about God. I also believe that they are like animals to themselves.
verses.19: For both human beings and animals die, and each of them dies in the same way. Similarly, one soul belongs to all of them. The difference between humans and animals is that everything becomes worthless when it dies.
verses.20: Everything went to one place. Everything came from the sky, and everything returned to the sky.
verses.21: Who knows that the spirit of human beings rises upward, while the spirit of animals descends downward toward the earth?
verses.22: And I saw that there is no good in what a person does, just for the sake of rejoicing in those actions. After all, he is just part of them. Who can bring him to see what will happen to his descendants?
